newsitem.title: USA: Streicher Mobile sees $0.08/shr loss in Q2.
newsitem.headline: Streicher Mobile sees $0.08/shr loss in Q2.

text.p: Streicher Mobile Fueling Inc said Monday that it expects to record a loss of at least $200,000, or $0.08 a share, in the first quarter ended April 30, as a result of expanded marketing costs.

The company said that its aggressive marketing plans will result in larger expenses near-term, and that start-up costs with new customers, the purchasing of trucks and systems, and expansion into new markets will continue to adversely impact near-term operating results.

Streicher said that in the last four months it has entered into numerous pilot programs with prospective customers, expanded service to existing accounts in new locations and concluded agreements for more than two dozen new customer locations.
